connectedAccounts.title: Connected Accounts
connectedAccounts.subtitle: Connect your own Google account so Aexy can work with your mail and calendar. This is yours — you don't need an admin to do it for you.

google.heading: Google
google.label: Your connected Google accounts
google.footer: You see your own accounts here. Owners and admins see every account in the workspace, and a department head sees their department's. Disconnecting stops future syncing; mail already synced stays.

what.heading: What connecting does
what.serviceDesk: Lets your address be used as a Service Desk mailbox, so tickets can be answered from it.
what.crm: Syncs mail and calendar against CRM records, so conversations and meetings show up on the right contact.
what.shared: A workspace can hold several Google accounts. Connecting adds yours alongside the others rather than replacing them.
